meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Payment System Indicators (via DBIE)
meta.revisionPolicy: Monthly figures are provisional when first printed and may be revised in later Bulletins; the RBI re-organised the table in November 2019, and the two layouts are kept apart.
meta.coverage: The RBI's payment system table in its old layout, April 2004 to October 2019: RTGS, CCIL, paper clearing, ECS, NEFT, IMPS, NACH, card usage at ATMs and PoS, prepaid instruments and mobile banking, number and value
meta.note: RBI Bulletin Table 45 (old layout) via DBIE report 612 (ACTUALS display unit). Debit and credit card lines include cash drawn at ATMs. UPI is not a line of this layout. Retired in November 2019; never joined to the re-organised table.
